description: This Java source file defines a class 'Substitution' used for variable substitution in strings. It supports replacement of variables in the format '${xxx}', execution of methods on variables, and macro evaluation. It manages sources for variables, handles special keys like '${TODAY}', and provides utility methods for substitution with macro support.

classes.name: Substitution
classes.description: Main class providing variable substitution with macro evaluation, method execution on variables, and source management.

classes.name: InternalSource
classes.description: Internal class implementing SubstitutionSource, providing predefined variable values like today's date, yesterday, tomorrow, system temp directory, and random numbers.

methods.name: substitute
methods.description: Performs substitution on the input string, replacing variables and macros with their values, supporting nested macros.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Resolves a variable name (with optional method execution) by querying sources and applying methods.

methods.name: legacySubstitute
methods.description: Performs variable substitution for legacy syntax using '@...@' notation.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Parses and evaluates a macro expression line, supporting '#if' style macros.

methods.name: addSubstitutionSource
methods.description: Adds a new SubstitutionSource to the list of sources for variable resolution.

methods.name: getSources
methods.description: Returns the list of current SubstitutionSources.

methods.name: addMethodResolver
methods.description: Adds a MethodResolver to the list for executing methods on variable values.

methods.name: getResolvers
methods.description: Returns the list of current MethodResolvers.

methods.name: isIgnoreMacros
methods.description: Returns whether macro processing is ignored.

methods.name: setIgnoreMacros
methods.description: Sets whether macro processing should be ignored.
